batch_report.accounting_scope: Recorded episode costs include failed and incomplete work. Missing fields and unattached physics are explicit; totals may be partial. Elapsed seconds are sums across episodes, not batch wall time.
batch_report.interpretation: Outcome counts cover only validated completed episodes; all other planned jobs remain in statuses. A missing process record does not prove a process is live. This report makes no causal or safety guarantee.

comparison_scope: Outcome transitions use only cases where both episodes completed and validated. Every planned or unmatched case remains visible. Partial comparisons are not a balanced condition ranking.
cost_scope: Whole-batch recorded_cost_totals count each episode once, including failed and partial work. Pair totals cover only the completed pairs in that comparison, and are null if a required cost is missing. Controls can appear in several comparisons; never sum pair totals as whole-study costs.
interpretation: Shared scene/root seeds do not imply identical initial images or physical trajectories. These are descriptive outcome comparisons, not causal counterfactuals or an evolutionary-advantage claim.
scope: Alternate control label on the same physical batch; these costs are not additional simulator work.
